biography: An innovative executive with success managing projects across APAC, EMEA and the US. Significant experience as a Quantity Surveyor/Cost Estimator, Cost Controller, and Planning Professional solving the needs of a diverse clientele. Offering clear strategic vision and the execution ability necessary to deliver measurable and sustainable results in the EPC industry. Proficient in the use of Power-BI, Bid-to-Win, InEight Estimate, & Aspen Capital Cost Estimator/ICARUS to estimate the cost of Refineries, Pipelines, Process Plants, Combine Cycle Power Plants, and Production Systems. Also experienced in Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), and Building lnformation Modeling (BIM) via the application of Revit Architecture, Synchro, Assemble, & Navisworks Manage. My experiences are in the EPCI of Offshore Oil & Gas Platforms, Jackets, Decks/Topsides, Manifolds, FPSO’s, and Pipelines. I am also experienced in the design & construction of Gas/Steam Turbines, HRSG’s, Generators, Chemical Plants, Refineries, Airports, Roads, Bridges, and Commercial/Residential Buildings. As a Professional, I determine the preliminary and detailed estimates, including the duration of projects using Primavera, MS Project & Excel. This is achieved via a symbiotic relationship between the departmental heads: Engineering, Fabrication, Cost Control, Human resources, Procurement & Logistics. The application of labor productivity rates from the company's database to approximate quantities at different WBS's helps in developing an Order of Magnitude Estimate. Preparing detailed cost estimates includes using the MTO's from the Engineering, applying labor constants to determine manpower and equipment required for each task, and extracting the necessary information from the specifications, project schedule, equipment data, and inputs from departmental heads. I worked for SAIPEM as a Cost Engineer for the EGINA UMBILICAL FLOWLINE AND RISER PROJECT. This is an EPCI project for the subsea field development which includes; fabrication & installation of piles, jackets, LBL array, FLETs, PLEMs, pipe-in-pipe, & risers. My duties included but not limited to estimating, cost control & monitoring using earned value, & progress measurement. I worked with ALCON for the construction of the Akwa-Ibom International Airport, Nigeria, and also with GITTO for the construction of roads, bridges, and power plants.
